name: image-generation-cellcog
description: AI image generation and photo editing powered by CellCog. Text-to-image, image-to-image, consistent characters, product photography, reference-based generation, style transfer, sets of images, social

en.tagline: AI image generation and editing through CellCog
en.summary: This skill generates and edits images with AI through CellCog. You describe the image in a text prompt, or pass an existing image to edit or use as a reference. It covers single images, consistent characters across a set, product shots, and campaign image sets.
problem: Teams that need images often must produce each one by hand, or write a separate prompt for every variation. Keeping a character, style, or product looking the same across many images is hard to do by hand.

With this skill, you write one prompt that describes the image, the style, and the aspect ratio and size. You can ask for a set of related images in the same request, or a character shown in several scenes. You can also pass an existing image to edit it or to match its style.
fit: Single images, edits, and small sets of related visuals
Consistent characters, mascots, comics, or storyboards
Product photography and social media or ad image sets
unfit: Deep research tasks, since the skill says Agent Team mode is for research and not for image generation
Setups where CellCog and a CELLCOG_API_KEY are not available
steps: Read the cellcog skill for the full SDK reference before the first CellCog task in a session.
Write a prompt that describes the subject, style, lighting, mood, composition, aspect ratio, and size.
Call `client.create_chat` with the prompt, a `task_label`, and `chat_mode="agent"`, which uses the core tier by default.
On OpenClaw, the call runs in the background and notifies the session key you pass. On other agents, the call blocks until the task is done and returns the result.
If the quality is not good enough or the work is complex, run the same prompt again with `chat_tier="max"`.
For character series, describe the character in detail first, then refer to 'the same character' in later prompts.

zh.tagline: 通过 CellCog 生成和编辑 AI 图像
zh.summary: 该技能通过 CellCog 用 AI 生成和编辑图像。你可以用文字描述想要的画面，也可以传入已有图片进行编辑或作为参考。它适用于单张图片、跨多张图保持角色一致、产品图以及营销图片组。
problem: 团队经常需要大量图片，如果逐张手工制作，或为每个变体单独写提示词，工作量很大。要在多张图里保持角色、风格或产品外观一致，手工做也很难。
使用该技能时，你只需写一段提示词，描述画面、风格、比例和尺寸，就能生成图片。你可以在同一次请求中要求生成一组相关图片，或让同一角色出现在多个场景中。你也可以传入已有图片，进行编辑或让新图匹配其风格。
fit: 单张图片、图片编辑和小批量相关视觉素材
角色、吉祥物、漫画或分镜的一致性创作
产品摄影，以及社交媒体或广告图片组
unfit: 深度研究类任务，因为该技能说明 Agent Team 模式用于研究，而非图像生成
无法使用 CellCog 或没有 CELLCOG_API_KEY 的环境
steps: 在会话中第一次执行 CellCog 任务前，先阅读 cellcog 技能中完整的 SDK 说明。
编写提示词，描述主体、风格、光线、氛围、构图、宽高比和尺寸。
调用 `client.create_chat`，传入提示词、`task_label`，并设置 `chat_mode="agent"`，默认使用 core 档位。
在 OpenClaw 上，调用会在后台运行，并通知你传入的会话键。在其他代理上，调用会阻塞直到任务完成并返回结果。
如果质量不够理想或任务较复杂，用 `chat_tier="max"` 重新运行同一提示词。
制作角色系列时，先详细描述角色，之后的提示词中再引用“同一角色”。
